description: This PHP source file defines a utility class 'JsonRPCServerUtils' for handling JSON-RPC server operations within the SuiteCRM project. The class includes methods for constructing SQL WHERE clauses based on query conditions and for authenticating users via session data, utilizing existing CRM components like BeanFactory and database managers.

classes.name: JsonRPCServerUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for constructing database queries and user authentication in a SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: constructWhere
methods.description: Builds an SQL WHERE clause string based on provided query conditions, supporting specific field operations and email-based conditions.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on session variables and system configuration, retrieving user details from the database if valid.
